title: When Correct Memory Goes Wrong: Fuzzing Persistent Memory Use in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.38275v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Persistent memory helps LLM agents carry information across long interactions, but correct memory can still be used incorrectly when queries change or memory states evolve. Existing work mainly studies memory content errors or evaluates fixed test cases, leaving memory-use failures hard to discover systematically. We formulate this issue as a fuzzing problem and categorize such failures into query-related and memory-state failures. We then develop U-Fuzz, which starts from memory checkpoints as test seeds, mutates queries or memory states under explicit mutation obligations, validates each mutant, and uses observed memory behavior to guide iterative testing while keeping failure labels outside the search. We evaluate U-Fuzz across several memory systems against diverse fuzzing baselines, and further test an output-only setting with API-based LLMs where memory retrieval is hidden. Across these settings, U-Fuzz consistently uncovers more

translated_title: 当正确的记忆出错时：对LLM智能体持久记忆使用的模糊测试
translated_abstract: 持久记忆帮助LLM智能体在长交互中携带信息，但当查询发生变化或记忆状态不断演化时，正确的记忆仍然可能被错误使用。现有工作主要研究记忆内容错误或仅评估固定测试用例，导致记忆使用故障难以被系统地发现。我们将该问题形式化为一个模糊测试问题，并将此类故障分为查询相关故障和记忆状态故障两类。随后我们开发了U-Fuzz，它以记忆检查点作为测试种子，在显式变异义务的约束下对查询或记忆状态进行变异，验证每个变异体，并利用观察到的记忆行为来指导迭代测试，同时将故障标签排除在搜索过程之外。我们在多个记忆系统上针对多样化的模糊测试基线对U-Fuzz进行了评估，并进一步在基于API的LLM的仅输出设置下进行了测试，在该设置中记忆检索过程是隐藏的。在这些设置中，U-Fuzz持续发现了更多的故障。
tldr: 提出U-Fuzz模糊测试框架，通过以记忆检查点为种子变异查询与记忆状态，系统地发现LLM智能体持久记忆使用中的故障。
en_tdlr: Proposes U-Fuzz, a fuzzing framework that systematically uncovers memory-use failures in LLM agents by seeding from memory checkpoints and mutating queries and memory states.
